main_text.l: [illegible, ~40 letters] [illegible, ~30 letters] [illegible, ~35 letters] [illegible, ~30 letters]
Animæ fidelium, si inquinatæ non fuerint,
lætitia quadam spirituali exultant, ex perceptio-
ne precum pro se: si vero fuerint inquinatæ, per-
ceptione precum pro se magis satagunt ad abster-
gendā sua Specula a maculis, quæ eis adhærent,
ac tanquam submersi quidam a suis adiuti so-
ciis sese mouent ad salutem. Ego vero maius
agnosco emolumentum ex precibus, piorum
porro hominum virtutibus præditorum, quia
se conformando anima inquinata animabus
eorum, diuinis informatis imaginibus, ipsa
quoque deificatis illis sese infinuabit, & confor-
matione ad eas satis digna fiet. Infidelibus autem
nulla prodest oratio, quia lumine carent, quem-
admodum illa Samuelis minime Sauli profuit, &
Hebrais illæ Prophetarum, qui pro eis gra-
re satagebant. Hoc quippe redarguuntur: pe-
titis, & non accipietis, eo quod male petatis.
Nestoriani in libro Constitutionum Ec-
clesiasticarum Collect. Hebediesu capite [illegible, ~25 letters]

page.notes: The Syriac heading at the top (four lines) and the Syriac line at the foot are not legible letter by letter at this scan resolution, so they are marked illegible. Possible printing error: "piorum" is followed by a dash mark at the line end; it is copied as "piorum" with the dash not reproduced. The catchword "De" is at the right below the last line. Long s is normalised to s and i/j to the Latin vowel/consonant form (e.g. "socijs" to "sociis" in the scan's spelling).
